verses.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਮੁਹੁ ਖਾਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: galee saadh na aaviee jichar muh khaalee|

en.bdb: So long as a tasty object enters not the mouth, mere talking about taste cannot bring any joy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੁ ਭਰਿਐ ਕਿਉਂ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਰਸ ਜੀਭ ਰਸਾਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: muh bhariaai kiau(n) boleeaai ras jeebh rasaalee|

en.bdb: When holding the object the mouth is full of taste and tongue full of delight, how could one speak?

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਨਹਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat simaran ula(n)gh neh nadhar nihaalee|

en.bdb: Going past the stage of recitation those whose consciousness gets merged in the Word, do not see anything except the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਥੁ ਕੁਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਅਲਮਸਤ ਖਿਆਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)th kupa(n)th na sujhiee alamasat khiaalee|

en.bdb: For the people drenched in love, good or bad ways have not meaning.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਗਮਗ ਚਾਲ ਸੁਢਾਲ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ।
verses.translit_en: ddagamag chaal suddaal hai gurmat niraalee|

en.bdb: Wobbling gait of the person full of love for the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat) looks distinctly beautiful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੜਿਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਲੁਕਈ ਢਕਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੁਨਾਲੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: chaRiaa cha(n)dh na lukiee ddak jot kunaalee ||6||

en.bdb: Now the moon emerged in the sky of heart cannot remain hidden in spite of efforts to cover its light with flour kneading basin.
